description: Cross-driver regression corpus for the personal-info dynamic-hotstrings prefix-counting logic. Every vector must pass in both the AHK and Hammerspoon driver test suites without modification. 'prefix_count_vectors' pins compute_prefix_counts() (the phone/SSN/IBAN threshold arithmetic, mirrored by AHK's CountDynamicSection and Lua's compute_prefix_counts); 'spaced_prefix_vectors' pins spaced_prefix() (the shortest-prefix-containing-N-non-space-chars helper). Expected values are computed programmatically from the shared Lua reference (_shared/lua/dynamic_hotstrings/init.lua), not hand-typed.

prefix_count_vectors.description: No personal data at all — every prefix count is 0.
Phone below the 2-digit threshold — no phone prefixes yet.
Phone at the 2-digit threshold — first tier fires (+2).
3 digits — still only the 2-digit tier (formatted phone too short for the 5-char fphone tier).
4 raw digits crosses BOTH the 4-digit tier AND the 5-char formatted-phone tier (2+2+1=5).
5 raw digits — still below the 6-digit tier; fphone tier already counted.
6 raw digits crosses the final phone tier — all four phone tiers now fire (2+2+1+1=6).
A full 10-digit French phone number — the count is capped at 6 by the fixed tiers, not proportional to length.
SSN below the 5-digit threshold — no SSN prefixes.
SSN at the 5-digit threshold — both the no-space and spaced triggers fire.
A full 15-digit French SSN — still only 2 prefixes (the threshold is a gate, not a per-digit count).
IBAN below the 6-char threshold — no IBAN prefixes.
IBAN at the 6-char threshold — both the no-space and 7-char spaced triggers fire.
A full 27-char French IBAN — still only 2 prefixes (threshold gate, not per-char count).
Phone + SSN + IBAN all present — each field's count is independent of the others.

spaced_prefix_vectors.description: Returns the prefix ending right after the raw_count-th non-space character.
Requesting more non-space chars than the string has returns the whole string.
raw_count=0 still consumes one character — the >= check fires on the very first iteration.
A string with no spaces behaves like a plain substring.
A leading space is not counted toward raw_count but is included in the returned prefix.
